style: Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. ONE children's science picture book illustration, landscape aspect 1216:832. Warm watercolor and colored pencils on fine cream paper, friendly refined rounded shapes, clear educational detail and believable construction, age 4-8. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or panel borders. Leave important objects comfortably inside margins. No baked-in arrows; all labels and arrows are added separately by the website.
scenes: Cover: friendly but mechanically credible tall WHITE two-stage rocket with blue nose cone, thin orange band, small round dark window in upper crew/payload section, short stabilizing fins at base. Launching vertically from distant safe launchpad into bright blue sky, single orange engine plume down into white exhaust cloud, green coast far below. No faces or logos.

Vertical whole rocket cutaway overview, complete nose to engine in frame on pale sky background. Blue pointed nose cone at top, round upper-section window, transparent central body section reveals cylindrical fuel tank, engine bell at bottom, short fins attached symmetrically around base. No floating detached components, no launch flame. All five parts large clear teaching targets.

Close technical cutaway of rocket lower body: separate fuel and oxidizer tanks upper section, feed pipes descend to compact combustion chamber center, bell nozzle bottom visibly opens downward; hot orange gas confined inside chamber and exits DOWN into clear space. White and blue shell partially removed, no fire inside fuel tank, no humans. Focus fuel storage, engine and exhaust.

Mission control room, two adult engineers seated at consoles. Large central screen shows same rocket upright on distant launchpad and THREE simple unnumbered round countdown lamps in a row above image; engineer's hand ready beside guarded red LAUNCH BUTTON foreground-right. No written digits or labels; website supplies countdown numbers. Safe indoor control location far from pad.

Dynamic low-angle rocket liftoff, same white-blue-orange rocket moving straight upward, engine bell emits bright tapered orange exhaust DOWN, enormous white exhaust clouds stay at launchpad below; service tower separated to left, no people nearby. Clear gap between rocket and pad, entire rocket upper threequarters inside frame, not missile warfare.

Educational action-reaction diagram base art: rocket suspended vertically at center-right with engine nozzle and a clearly downward narrow plume. Small inflated blue balloon at upper-left with open neck pointing downward and loose gas wisps below, as a simple analogy, no string tied shut. Quiet cream-blue background leaves large open space above rocket and below plume for SVG arrows. NO baked arrows, labels or hands.

Stage separation in upper atmosphere: small upper stage with blue nose continues upward at upper-right, engine nozzle pointed down; larger empty lower cylindrical stage drifting down-left with open coupling ring facing upper stage and engine at its own bottom. Clear GAP and matching structural connection size. Earth's blue curve below, no random shards, no sideways boosters, no parachute.

Spaceflight view: small upper rocket stage at far-right above curved blue-green Earth filling lower-left, thin atmospheric rim, dark navy starfield upper half. No flames shaped as atmospheric clouds, no characters floating outside without suits, no city in space. Earth and stars clearly separated for hotspots.

Orbit deployment concept: blue-green Earth lower-left, small upper rocket stage upper-right with opened payload fairing; compact recoverable research satellite just separated beside it, gold-silver central return module and TWO blue rectangular solar panels unfolded. One subtle thin elliptical orbital path around Earth may be added by website, leave blank space for it; NO baked path or arrow.

Closeup of recoverable research satellite: central gold-silver short conical module with dark protected base, round CAMERA aperture front-left, small parabolic communications ANTENNA on upper-right, exactly TWO blue grid solar wings attached symmetrically left and right. Deep navy space, Earth below background. Clear camera lens vs dish, no text, no flags.

Reentry of recoverable satellite's return module ONLY after detachable solar wings and antenna have been left behind. Short blunt conical silver-gold capsule, broad BLACK HEAT SHIELD faces DOWN-LEFT leading into atmosphere, bright orange plasma sheath hugs leading surface and trails up-right. Earth blue atmospheric rim below. No solar panels in flames, no ordinary intact satellite pretending to land.

Final descent of same conical silver-gold return module with black bottom heat shield under huge inflated orange-white parachute. Taut suspension lines connect canopy to capsule top, green open landing plain below. Blue sky and soft clouds. No solar wings, no flame, no active rocket stack, one capsule only.

Welcome home view from hillside: safe returned silver-gold capsule upright on grassy landing zone with folded orange-white parachute behind. Small distant recovery crew and vehicle, lush blue-green Earth landscape including ocean and gentle fields. A small inset globe of Earth upper-left separated on open sky as context, no arrows or text. No house in capsule, no fire.

Recap composition on pale sky: large beautiful blue-green Earth globe left, small rocket and satellite represented as separate miniature objects upper-right, silver-gold returned capsule on a safe green landing meadow lower-right, folded parachute beside it. Clear globe and landing/home targets, no orbital path suggesting Sun circles Earth, no written labels.
